title: Skiwi Rentals
specs: Sign the waiver immediately The rental customer must be 21 years old and other drivers must be 18 years old or older (NRS 488.730 Para 3).
Rental customer & drivers must be present at Skiwi before or at pickup time with valid Photo ID.
All watercraft must be off the water by sunset.
